title: Stephen F Austin State University (SFA)
summary: Stephen F Austin State University (SFA) is a university in Nacogdoches. This entry compiles College Scorecard figures and related sources; UniRepository is not affiliated with SFA.

sections.heading: What SFA is known for
paragraphs: Stephen F Austin State University (SFA) is a public institution known for its diverse academic offerings and significant undergraduate enrollment of 8,728 students. The university has a high admission rate of approximately 94%, reflecting its inclusive admissions policy. SFA is particularly recognized for its strong programs in business and health-related fields, with business programs comprising about 19.5% and health programs about 14.2% of the total academic offerings. These areas highlight the university's focus on preparing students for careers in dynamic and essential sectors.

sections.heading: How to read SFA tuition
paragraphs: Stephen F Austin State University (SFA) has distinct tuition rates for in-state and out-of-state students. The tuition for in-state students is $11,128, while out-of-state students pay a higher rate of $23,426. These figures represent the base tuition costs for attending SFA.

The total cost of attendance at SFA, which includes tuition along with additional expenses such as fees, housing, and other living costs, amounts to $25,791. Understanding these numbers helps prospective students and their families plan financially for enrollment at SFA.
